joshua.12.p1.b1.text: Now these are the kings of the land whom the Israelites struck down and whose lands they took beyond the Jordan to the east, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon, including all the Arabah eastward:

joshua.12.p1.b2.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon …

joshua.12.p1.b3.text: And Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of the Rephaim …

joshua.12.p1.b4.text: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites had struck them down and given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

joshua.12.p2.b1.text: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west …

joshua.12.p2.b2.text: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one;

joshua.12.p2.b3.text: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

joshua.12.p2.b4.text: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

joshua.12.p3.b1.text: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

joshua.12.p3.b2.text: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

joshua.12.p3.b3.text: … So there were thirty-one kings in all.
